title: Expand the function
text: Expanding $$\left(1+x^4\right)^{25}$$ gives a polynomial in which every power of $$x$$ is a multiple of $$4$$.

title: Relate the derivative to a coefficient
text: The 99th derivative at $$0$$ equals the coefficient of $$x^{99}$$ times $$99$$ factorial. Since $$99$$ is not a multiple of $$4$$, there is no $$x^{99}$$ term, so the answer is $$0$$.
